training.algorithm: Create ML ObjectPrint revision 1 transfer learning

scope: Food-region detection only. This does not measure food-name, weight, calorie, or nutrition accuracy.
known_limitations: Near-duplicate but byte-distinct photos may remain across splits.
UEC FOOD-256 is weighted toward Japanese and international dishes.
Per-item grams are allocated from a whole-photo estimate by detected box area.
